```python
import gurobipy as gp
from gurobipy import GRB
import json

# Jobdaten
jobs = {
    "0": {"processing_time": 3, "due_date": 620, "weight": 2},
    "1": {"processing_time": 92, "due_date": 373, "weight": 1},
    "2": {"processing_time": 3, "due_date": 428, "weight": 4},
    "3": {"processing_time": 39, "due_date": 129, "weight": 2},
    "4": {"processing_time": 1, "due_date": 451, "weight": 3},
    "5": {"processing_time": 87, "due_date": 447, "weight": 4},
    "6": {"processing_time": 68, "due_date": 429, "weight": 4},
    "7": {"processing_time": 78, "due_date": 472, "weight": 8},
    "8": {"processing_time": 42, "due_date": 618, "weight": 8},
    "9": {"processing_time": 88, "due_date": 515, "weight": 5},
    "10": {"processing_time": 43, "due_date": 508, "weight": 2},
    "11": {"processing_time": 33, "due_date": 414, "weight": 7},
    "12": {"processing_time": 24, "due_date": 419, "weight": 9},
    "13": {"processing_time": 45, "due_date": 144, "weight": 6},
    "14": {"processing_time": 55, "due_date": 471, "weight": 5},
    "15": {"processing_time": 51, "due_date": 397, "weight": 10},
    "16": {"processing_time": 80, "due_date": 558, "weight": 4},
    "17": {"processing_time": 100, "due_date": 213, "weight": 3},
    "18": {"processing_time": 30, "due_date": 338, "weight": 10},
    "19": {"processing_time": 2, "due_date": 332, "weight": 8}
}

# Erstelle ein Modell
model = gp.Model("single_machine_scheduling")
model.Params.OutputFlag = 0

# Variablen
n = len(jobs)
x = model.addVars(n, n, vtype=GRB.BINARY, name="x")
C = model.addVars(n, vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name="C")
T = model.addVars(n, vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name="T")

# Zielfunktion: Minimiere die gewichtete Summe der Verspätungen
model.setObjective(gp.quicksum(jobs[str(j)]["weight"] * T[j] for j in range(n)), GRB.MINIMIZE)

# Einschränkungen
# Jeder Job wird genau einmal eingeplant
model.addConstrs((gp.quicksum(x[i, j] for j in range(n)) == 1 for i in range(n)), name="assign_once")

# Jeder Platz wird genau einmal belegt
model.addConstrs((gp.quicksum(x[i, j] for i in range(n)) == 1 for j in range(n)), name="fill_once")

# Berechnung der Fertigstellungszeiten
model.addConstrs((C[j] >= gp.quicksum(jobs[str(i)]["processing_time"] * x[i, j] for i in range(n)) +
                  (C[j-1] if j > 0 else 0) for j in range(n)), name="completion_time")

# Berechnung der Verspätungen
model.addConstrs((T[j] >= C[j] - jobs[str(j)]["due_date"] for j in range(n)), name="tardiness")

# Optimierung
model.optimize()

# Bestimme die Sequenz
sequence = [j for j in range(n) for i in range(n) if x[i, j].X > 0.5]

# Ausgabe
result = {
    "sequence": sequence,
    "objective_value": model.ObjVal
}

print(json.dumps(result))
```
